name: code-review
description: Code review for C/C++ projects in three modes — function review, chain review, and feature review — backed by a WASM tree-sitter code index (web-tree-sitter + better-sqlite3). Bundles the three review skills and a stdio MCP server exposing the code index as tools.

com.agentemployee.client.title: Code Review
com.agentemployee.client.examplePrompt: Review the navigation module: run a function review over nav.c and report issues with location, type, severity, and a suggested fix.

function-review.name: Function Review
function-review.description: Review individual C/C++ functions: naming, complexity, error handling, resource/memory safety, null and bounds, magic numbers, returns, side effects, type safety, and documentation. Reports issues with file + stable locator, type, severity, and a suggested direction.

chain-review.name: Chain Review
chain-review.description: Trace a cross-function call path in C/C++: cycles, chain depth, data-flow breaks, swallowed errors, layering violations, lifetime/dangling references, inconsistent conditions, and shared-state races. Reports issues with file + stable locator, type, severity, and a suggested direction.

feature-review.name: Feature Review
feature-review.description: Audit a whole C/C++ feature against its requirements: completeness, boundaries, input validation, requirement mismatch, defaults, concurrency/timing, testability, cross-mode consistency, and documentation. Reports issues with file + stable locator, type, severity, and a suggested direction.

regression-review.name: Regression Review
regression-review.description: Regression review over a code change against an uploaded impact-analysis report: check consistency between the change and the report's claimed impact, and review the change itself for semantic problems. Uses the diff_paths MCP for change diffing. Reports issues with file + stable locator, type, severity, and a suggested direction.
